lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Tch—! I'm hurt worse than I thought. I can't keep swimming like this.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Kuda, stop. I'm taking you out of here.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: To the shore? I've never been out of the water...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll take care of you. Just let me help.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: ...Fine. Guess I'm counting on you, then.
